title: Myth: the anon key must be secret
why_it_matters: Knowing what is safe to expose stops both panic and real leaks.
explanation: The anon key is designed to live in browser code. What protects your data is row-level security, not hiding the key. With RLS enabled and no policies, the API returns no rows. Without RLS, anyone with the key can read the table.
code: alter table todos enable row level security;
try_it: Check in the dashboard that every table you made has RLS on.
